about.headline: Empowering communities through education and vocational skills.
about.body: Lagni Devi Memorial Foundation is a grassroots non-profit organisation dedicated to community empowerment. We focus on providing free education, vocational training, and organizing community welfare events. Our core programs include Basic Computer Skills & Digital Literacy, Spoken English & Communication, Women's Vocational Tailoring & Handicrafts, and Board Exam Intensive Coaching Camps to help youth and women build sustainable livelihoods.

vision.point1: Quality education for children from all backgrounds
vision.point2: Vocational skills & financial independence for women

timeline.2021: First free education camp; 50 students from 3 villages coached for board exams
timeline.2022: Expanded to 5 districts; first village health camp
timeline.2023: Launched Women's Skill Development Program; introduced online skill courses
